issue: The earlier main-grandstand roof used one bounding rectangle through a concave double-frontage complex. It covered 18,720 m² of the racing road, and its masts covered another 303 m².
correction: Retain the actual concave wings, central mall gaps and 3 m road margin. The lower front canopy edge rises toward the rear and branching ribs follow each pale membrane underside. Both top and soffit use White rather than the previous dark ochre Cream top. The former three black pit-roof strips and overlong generic pit building are replaced by the actual mapped compound, white terrace edges, distinct garage bays and one pale upper cantilever canopy.

source_support.supports: Operator description of the double-frontage grandstand and umbrella/palm-leaf roof.
Supplied reference shows repeated pale curved leaf modules, branching supports and seating facing both straights. Exact module dimensions remain estimates.
Operator architecture photo shows the pale membrane shells and visible underside fan/branch ribs; no source pixels enter game assets.

estimates.note: These are original visual reconstruction dimensions, not a structural survey.
estimates.roof_lobe_shape: Along-bay squared sine, scaled from 0.3 at the front to 1 at the rear; an unmeasured membrane reconstruction, not a structural analysis.

review_status: Source proof complete; fresh packaged appearance comparison pending. Prior footprint correction alone did not establish roof fidelity.
